name: dlc-3d-tests
description: Dev-only: jsdom for the module-load smoke tests. The modules ship as plain browser ES modules with no build step and no runtime dependencies. "type": "module" tells Node the same thing about .js files here — the browser already treats them as ESM via <script type=module>, and without it Node reads them as CommonJS and every named import fails. Verified: no file under src/static uses require() or module.exports.
